pending.headline: A licence badge proves nothing.
pending.text:
Headline: A licence badge proves nothing.
Supporting line: Anyone can paste one on a website. The regulator's register is the only proof.
Footer: Check the register, not the badge.
pending.caption: A regulator's logo on a website is an image. Anyone can paste one. The only proof is the regulator's own register, and it takes two minutes to search.

A score is where your research starts, not a recommendation.

queue.title: Meet TrustBrokerHub
queue.text: Carousel, 6 slides: 38,680 brokers. Which one do you trust? / 38,680 brokers and exchanges in one database / 105 regulators across 140 countries / A Trust Score on every broker / Scam alerts, trader reviews, side-by-side compare / Look them up before you pay them.
queue.caption:
38,680 brokers and exchanges. One question before you deposit: who are you actually dealing with?

TrustBrokerHub checks forex brokers, crypto exchanges and prop firms against 105 regulators in 140 countries. Every broker gets a transparent Trust Score, and scam alerts, reviews and a compare tool sit in one place.

Search any broker before you deposit. Link in bio.

queue.title: Top broker. According to who?
queue.text:
Headline: Top broker. According to who?
Supporting line: Not every broker ranking tells the full story.
Footer: Look beyond the ranking.
queue.caption: "Top broker" is a claim, not a fact. Most lists never say who paid for the position or what was measured. Before a ranking convinces you, ask what sits behind it.
